lines.1: 「--So it turned out we were related.」
lines.2: 「Huh. So you knew her before you met adorable little me.」
lines.3: 「Took you long enough to remember. You're still young, too.」
lines.4: 「Don't make it sound like I have amnesia. I'd unconsciously sealed away the terrifying memories.」
lines.5: 「Otome was kind, but she was even stricter... She scared me.」
lines.6: 「Subaru, when we first met, I wasn't afraid of you, remember?」
lines.7: 「Yeah. When I was a kid, normal guys like Fukahire just ignored me.」
lines.9: 「You and Crab were about the only ones who talked to me. And then I fell for you.」
lines.10: 「I keep telling you, stop making jokes like that!」
lines.11: 「Back then, compared to Otome, you weren't scary at all. That's what I mean.」
lines.12: 「Makes sense. Then I owe Otome my thanks.」
lines.13: 「Think I could get revenge on that woman if I took Leo hostage?」
lines.14: 「What would you even do after taking me hostage?」
lines.15: 「Give her a kicking from hell while yelling, 'Don't move!'」
lines.17: 「People who take hostages in movies and comics never meet a good end, do they?」
lines.19: That was exactly the sort of line spoken by someone with a one-hundred-percent chance of losing.
lines.20: 「What if somebody took Fukahire hostage, Leo?」
